coreAttributes.name: xiphos
coreAttributes.description: A double-edged, one-handed shortsword, with a straight, #IF(game.isMetricSizes())60cm#ELSE24 inch#ENDIF blade. The ancient Greeks used it as a secondary battlefield weapon after the dory or javelin.
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name] position [npc.her] xiphos at [npc.her] hip, ready to draw it at a moment's notice.
coreAttributes.unequipText: [npc.Name] sheath [npc.her] xiphos, before putting it away.

hitDescriptions.hitText: [npc.Name] slash [npc.her] xiphos at [npc2.name], grinning as the ethereal arcane blade travels through [npc2.her] body!
Slashing out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] xiphos, [npc.name] grin as [npc.she] see the ethereal blade travel straight through [npc2.her] body!
[npc.Name] slash at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] xiphos, causing [npc2.herHim] to stagger back as the ethereal blade passes right through [npc2.her] chest!

missDescriptions.missText: [npc.Name] slash [npc.her] xiphos at [npc2.name], but end up missing [npc2.herHim]!
Slashing out at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] xiphos, [npc.name] let out a frustrated cry as [npc.she] miss [npc.her] target!
With a quick step forwards, [npc.name] slash at [npc2.name] with [npc.her] xiphos, but [npc.she] miss [npc.her] target!
